fold: Nothing has ever forced this place to change much.

text: Reason settled: Sited on a route already worn deep before anyone built here, on the reasoning that a road a century old will not be abandoned in one.

text: Reason settled: Founded roadside, where the day is measured in traffic: what arrives before noon, what leaves before dusk, and what stops for the night.

text: The Siege is why this place looks as it does: it stood here before, but what stands today was rebuilt afterwards

fold: Reason settled: Built along the river: water access shapes every economic decision.
text: Reason settled: Built along the river: water access shapes every economic decision.

text: Reason settled: Sited at the water's edge because the river was the only road worth having, and it has been the argument for staying ever since.

text: Reason settled: Founded at a junction on the oldest logic there is: whoever holds the meeting of roads holds what moves along them.

text: Reason settled: Built at a major crossroads, and trade comes in on every road.

text: Reason settled: A road settlement: it makes its living from other people's journeys, in stabling and meals and small repairs.

why: 'lower districts', 'street by street', 'whole quarters' in a town of 357; HOUSES has no districts or quarters

text: This place made its name in trade, not war, and the Economic Divide showed it that money lasts longer here than any military glory
